opening.argument: The video cites a 4,870% past increase, described as multiplying an initial investment by 50, then projects a $120–$160 price range with another 4.5-times increase. It also urges attention to timing, warning that when more people know about cryptocurrency, it may be later to invest in these projects. Together, the past-return comparison, specific upward price projection and time-sensitive investment cue promote LUNA as an opportunity for appreciation. The speaker does disclaim investment advice and calls the video educational, but that disclaimer does not remove the surrounding return-focused pitch. The separate raffle is not part of the investment mechanism.
